summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file `math_init.js` (~727KB, heavily obfuscated with a string-rotation array and hex identifiers). Execution occurs automatically on `npm install`, before any consumer code runs. Both the loader (`setup.mjs`) and the executed payload are obfuscated: `setup.mjs` uses obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers and per-function dictionaries that indirect every string literal (including the download URL and target filename), and `math_init.js` opens with `// @bun @bun-cjs` followed by a `WV8StW` rotation function and a large opaque literal dictionary with no readable identifiers. The alternate-runtime dropper shape — executing a bundled obfuscated payload through a freshly downloaded second interpreter — bypasses Node-only inspection of the executed code, and the filename `math_init.js` presents as inert math initialization while the file is opaque bundled logic unrelated to any documented function of a chatbot UI package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
